mapper.select: SELECT scope_type FROM admin_role_data_scope WHERE role_id=#{roleId} ORDER BY scope_type
SELECT merchant_id FROM admin_user_merchant_scope WHERE user_id=#{userId} ORDER BY merchant_id

choose.when: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM merchant WHERE merchant_id IN #{id} AND status='ACTIVE'

mapper.select: SELECT EXISTS( SELECT 1 FROM admin_user u WHERE u.username=#{username} AND u.status='ACTIVE' AND ( EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM admin_user_role ur JOIN admin_role_data_scope ds ON ds.role_id=ur.role_id WHERE ur.user_id=u.id AND ds.scope_type='ALL') OR NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM admin_user_merchant_scope ums WHERE ums.user_id=u.id) ) )

SELECT EXISTS( SELECT 1 FROM merchant m JOIN admin_user u ON u.username=#{username} AND u.status='ACTIVE' WHERE m.merchant_id=#{merchantId} AND ( EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM admin_user_role ur JOIN admin_role_data_scope ds ON ds.role_id=ur.role_id WHERE ur.user_id=u.id AND ds.scope_type='ALL') OR NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM admin_user_merchant_scope ums WHERE ums.user_id=u.id) OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM admin_user_merchant_scope ums WHERE ums.user_id=u.id AND ums.merchant_id=m.merchant_id) ) )
